message.content:
A magazine cover for "TEMPO" features a digital illustration of a man standing on a roadside, viewed from behind. He wears a white, rumpled long-sleeved shirt tucked into dark gray trousers and holds a dark jacket in his left hand. His right arm is extended outward with a thumb raised. He has short dark hair and wears dark-rimmed glasses.

To his left, a large teal and gray bus faces forward. The digital display on the bus reads "KIM PLUS" in glowing red letters. The man stands on an asphalt road with a faint white line, set against a hazy, yellowish landscape under a blue sky with white clouds.

The top of the cover contains the white "TEMPO" logo on a blue background, above a red horizontal bar. Below the logo, text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Headlines include "Perdagangan Orang Pekerja Judi Online H.68" and "Tarik-Ulur Cukai Minuman Berpemanis H.80". Large white text on the right reads "SKENARIO KOTAK KOSONG," followed by a paragraph of smaller white text and "H.26." A barcode and QR code are in the upper right.
